error.signature: AI states as a blanket nationwide rule that Taiwan tap water is always safe to drink straight from the faucet, or that it must always be boiled first no matter what

verdict.summary: Taiwan's water utilities treat tap water to meet the national Drinking Water Quality Standard, and both the Taipei Water Department and Taiwan Water Corporation say it can be consumed directly as it leaves their monitored system. But both utilities and the Ministry of Environment separately warn that quality can still degrade afterward inside a building's own storage tanks and pipes if those aren't cleaned regularly (recommended every 6-12 months), so whether a specific tap is safe to drink untreated depends on that building's maintenance, not on a single nationwide answer.

dead_ends.action: Tell someone in Taiwan that tap water is either always safe to drink straight from any faucet, or that it must always be boiled first, as a single nationwide rule
dead_ends.why_fails: Taipei Water Department's official FAQ states treated water meets the Drinking Water Quality Standard and 'can be consumed directly' leaving their system, but warns quality can still be compromised afterward, comparing it to 'pouring clean water into a dirty cup' (如同乾淨的水裝入髒的杯子) if a building's tanks and pipes are not maintained. Taiwan Water Corporation and the Ministry of Environment separately document secondary-contamination risks from aged pipes, oversized tanks, and negative-pressure backflow after service interruptions, and urge residents to have tanks cleaned every 6-12 months.
dead_ends.condition: Older apartment buildings or homes with rooftop storage tanks
dead_ends.common_misconception: That the utility's own water-quality guarantee still holds unchanged once water has passed through a specific building's internal tanks and pipes.

workarounds.action: Ask or check when a building's rooftop water tank was last cleaned (should be within the last 6-12 months per official guidance) before assuming its tap water is directly drinkable; when unknown, boil the water or use a filtered dispenser, which is what most Taiwanese households do by habit regardless of the official safety guarantee at the treatment plant
workarounds.condition: General household or short-term rental in Taiwan
